newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: RESEARCH ALERT - CANTV started as sell.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - CANTV started as sell.

text.p: Paribas initiated coverage of Venezuelan telephone company CANTV with an overvalued, sell recommendation.
-- Analyst William Beavington cited: "the most fragile tariff rebalancing regime in the sector, the most belligerent labor union and a currency which could devalue by 46 percent in 1999".

-- He said: "For a newly listed operator, CANTV offers investors the lowest rates of wireline and cellular growth in Latin America. Cellular subscriber revenues are already at US levels and going lower with forecast subscriber growth already below those found in the US."
-- He said: "stock momentum seems to continue only if rates of return of equity also continue to appreciate. CANTV's ROE falls in 1997 and then stagnates."
-- "Our 12-month target price for CANTV is $39.5," the analyst said.
-- midday Thursday, the stock was flat at 38-3/4.
